design.analysis: Charge full validation and qualification for a direct fresh path. Price optimistic moves using only favorable replies required for an exact binary certificate. Assume earlier validation rows are cached for any incumbent and any earlier offer is archived. Both path builders skip optional work and use no holdout outcomes until scoring.
design.priceLimit: Paid search plus qualification of the measured CPO episode, independently for each seed.
design.qualify: Strict exact gain, with nonnegative gain in both halves when leaving the start.
